title: Visual edits
body: Change spacing, colour and type on the running page and keep a record of every change.

title: Layout shifts
body: See which element moved during load, what pushed it and where it lives in the source.

title: Side effects
body: Each edit lists the other elements that changed size or position because of it.

title: Agent handoff
body: Send the recorded changes to a coding agent over MCP or copy them as a prompt.

title: Verification
body: After the agent edits the code the page is measured again and compared with the request.

title: Source lines
body: Every element is traced back to the file and line that rendered it.
